page: Amazon Web Services r6in.24xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running on the x86_64 instruction set architecture, delivering 96 virtual central processing units across 48 physical execution cores at clock frequencies up to 3.5 GHz. The processor includes 54 MB of shared L3 cache and supports instruction extensions including AVX-512, VAES, and SHA-NI cryptographic acceleration. Memory configuration includes 768.0 GB of DDR4 system memory clocked at 3 GHz, offering an 8:1 ratio of memory to vCPUs.

Network infrastructure is a focal capability of the r6in.24xlarge, offering a baseline throughput of 150 Gbps without bundled local instance storage. Memory bandwidth benchmarks reflect this high-throughput design, delivering 313.67 GB/sec in uncached 256 MB sequential read operations and 136.45 GB/sec in large write operations. Compute-bound multi-threaded testing shows high throughput, with Geekbench multi-core reaching 17,468 and PassMark CPU score reaching 75,961.98. Hardware encryption throughput is elevated, driven by AES and VAES hardware support, ranking in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems.

Because the server omits local NVMe SSD storage, all persistent block storage must be mounted over the network via EBS or remote targets. This architecture optimizes resource density for high-throughput enterprise databases, large-scale Redis in-memory caches, distributed analytics engines, and real-time data streaming applications requiring substantial memory allocation and extensive network bandwidth per node.
description: Amazon Web Services r6in.24xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 96 vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8375C processor and 768.0 GB of 3 GHz DDR4 RAM on the Nitro system. Offering an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside a 150 Gbps baseline network interface, this instance delivers high network capacity and significant memory throughput, logging 313.67 GB/sec in uncached block read operations and 86.05 million Redis SET operations per second. Hardware includes advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators, achieving top-tier encryption scores. The instance provides no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached EBS or remote block devices. The r6in.24xlarge is suited for memory-bound relational databases, large in-memory caches, high-throughput analytics, and distributed data processing frameworks requiring broad network connectivity.
